design: Four simplified replacements: photo announcement, bounded tools-to-component workflow, user acceptance, preview versus accepted state. Five preceding cards unchanged.

assets.altText: “Local models. Real limits.” November 2026 web LLM update, with Brian Love’s original airport photograph on a charcoal and amber card.

provenance.source: IMG_6068.HEIC / photo kit v02 sRGB original photograph; authored headline
provenance.treatment: Hashbrown palette; original photo or explicitly labeled conceptual illustration. No replay screenshots or fabricated model output.

assets.altText: “Tools → One component.” A simple illustration connects selected tools to one component. A caption reads “Tested in Chrome + WebLLM.” This summarizes the bounded qualified workflow; it is not a model-output screenshot.

provenance.source: Authored diagram summarizing the single-component tool workflows qualified in the November web LLM update
provenance.treatment: Hashbrown palette; original photo or explicitly labeled conceptual illustration. No replay screenshots or fabricated model output.

assets.altText: Illustration: “Valid JSON. Wrong answer.” The request says 2, but valid JSON contains {"count":3}. Shape passes while values fail. This is an explanatory example, not a captured model result.

provenance.source: Authored HTML/CSS explanatory example of schema validity versus requested values
provenance.treatment: HTML/CSS composition in Hashbrown palette; original photograph or unchanged recorded replay crop; authored explanations labeled Illustration; no generated face or model result

assets.altText: “The app picks the tool.” An illustration of structured tool phases: the app selects a tool, the model generates arguments, Hashbrown validates and runs the tool, then the model generates output.

provenance.source: Authored HTML/CSS illustration of opt-in structured tool phases
provenance.treatment: HTML/CSS composition in Hashbrown palette; original photograph or unchanged recorded replay crop; authored explanations labeled Illustration; no generated face or model result
